Scholarship overview

Antarctica New Zealand's postgraduate awards support doctoral research relevant to Antarctica and the Southern Ocean. The award includes research support and field logistics, but applicants should arrange the rest of their doctoral funding rather than assume this award covers all tuition and living costs.

Research Areas

  • Antarctic research
  • Environmental science
  • Polar research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionDoctoral research award (partial funding)
Stipend / salaryNZD 20,000/year for two years, plus field logistics

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsResearch award; does not by itself guarantee full doctoral tuition funding.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusUpcoming: opens 9 February 2027
Deadline / consideration round16 March 2027
LocationNew Zealand
Details checked9 October 2026

How to Apply

  1. Review the official programme page and check the opening date for the next call.
  2. Use the new call to select a project or research area and identify the documents required for that application route.
  3. Complete the submission when the application window opens, using the new deadline rather than an earlier recruitment cycle.

About Antarctica New Zealand

Antarctica New Zealand supports research in Antarctica and the Southern Ocean. Its postgraduate research awards help researchers undertake relevant projects, including support connected to Antarctic fieldwork.
